name: web-search-refactor
description: web_search backend replacement: platform.iflow.cn search endpoint only accepts iFlow platform keys (probed: third-party profile keys rejected with code 90402), so the tool always fails on third-party profiles. Loader replaces the web_search instance executeInternal with an engine chain iflow -> bing scrape -> ddg. Config ~/.iflow/web-search.json. IFLOW_WEB_SEARCH=0|false reverts. ACP-only registration site untouched otherwise.
author: yuentao
